items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: And he threatened to fire Coleman Hawkins more than once, because Coleman used to come in late. Sometimes we'd open up and start playing, and here comes Coleman.

ctx.x: That was the big band, yeah. First big band, yeah. That was my first big band.

Well, Fletcher was a very -- he was a fellow that -- he was strict and nice and exact in everything he did. But he wasn't satisfied with his band. And he threatened to fire Coleman Hawkins more than once, because Coleman used to come in late. Sometimes we'd open up and start playing, and here comes Coleman. But when he'd get up there and pick that horn up, everybody was satisfied.
